\"Any customer can have a car painted any color that he wants so long as it is black.\" –Henry Ford
\"Aerodynamics are for people who can\'t build engines.\" –Enzo Ferrari
\"I couldn\'t find the sports car of my dreams, so I built it myself.\" –Ferdinand Porsche
\"If everything seems under control, you\'re just not going fast enough.\" –Mario Andretti
\"Horsepower sells cars, torque wins races.\" –Carroll Shelby
\"Racing is life. Anything before or after is just waiting.\" –Steve McQueen
\"Second place is just the first place loser.\" –Dale Earnhardt
\"Straight roads are for fast cars, turns are for fast drivers.\" –Colin McRae
\"If you no longer go for a gap, you are no longer a racing driver.\" –Ayrton Senna
\"The main thing is to finish. You cannot win if you don\'t finish.\" –Niki Lauda
\"Leave me alone, I know what I\'m doing.\" –Kimi Räikkönen
\"The only ones who remember you when you finish second are your wife and your dog.\" –Bobby Unser
\"To achieve anything, you must be prepared to dabble on the boundary of disaster.\" –Stirling Moss
\"If you have the passion for racing, you always find a way.\" –Walter Röhrl
\"Speed has never killed anyone. Suddenly becoming stationary, that\'s what gets you.\" –Jeremy Clarkson
\"A car for every purse and purpose.\" –Alfred P. Sloan
\"The car has become the carapace, the protective shell, of urban man.\" –Marshall McLuhan
\"Everything in life is somewhere else, and you get there in a car.\" –E.B. White
\"Life is measured in achievement, not in years alone.\" –Bruce McLaren
